messages:
kevin: Heads-up  the weekly KPI board is showing an unusual split for the launch webinar: RSVPs up ~30% but demo conversions down. Need a short source breakdown for the review.

ana: Noted. Can we see CPL by creative variant? I suspect the new passive CTA in the launch post drove volume but not intent.

josh: Running a quick slice now. SQL: ```SELECT creative_variant, source, count(*) as rsvps, sum(case when demo_requested then 1 else 0 end) as demos FROM webinar_signups WHERE event_date >= '2026-03-01' AND event_date <= '2026-03-28' GROUP BY creative_variant, source;``` Will export.

priya: Also check whether inbound routing sent webinar signups to the partner queue instead of SDRs. We had a playbook tweak last week that added a 12h nurture TTL.

tayla: Paid spend +12% that window; prospecting mix shifted to broad lookalikes. CPL rose 18%. If we keep broad audiences we should expect higher RSVPs and lower QL.

dashbot: Snapshot ready: https://dash.redwood.ai/s/weekly/launch-3421112222  includes creative split, source attribution, and 7d retention CSV.

josh: Export posted to the dash. Early numbers: variant-F (soft CTA) drove 60% of RSVPs but only 20% of demo requests. Variant-G (hard CTA) drove fewer RSVPs but a higher demo rate.

kevin: Quick plan for the KPI review: 1) show creative performance table, 2) show routing impact (nurture TTL vs immediate route) with a simulated SDR load, 3) recommend actions: tighten prospecting, revert CTA for retarget, compress TTL to 6h.

ana: I'll draft the benchmark paragraph comparing the last three launches: headline + delta + recommended comms language.

priya: I'll patch the playbook to immediate-route for 12h with a fallback to `partner-nurture` if queue > 40. Posting the small patch log here after I apply.

tayla: Budget doc updated: https://docs.redwood.ai/ads/launch-q2  reduced broad prospecting by 12% and increased retarget. Monitoring CPA.

kevin: Good. KPI huddle at 9:15am. Josh, bring the export slide. Ana, bring the comms snippet. If we see >15% QL drop before then, escalate in this thread. :eyes:
